fieldValues.title: Ready is filled to one global depth, so a group whose items rank later never gets any: the editor group starves
fieldValues.summary: Builders take only Ready issues, and board-sync's topup promotes Backlog items to Ready until 6 consumable items exist across every lane, in implementation order. Third-party-ready and unattended items already fill that depth, so topup never promotes the editor group's work. On 2026-11-02 WG Agent-supported editor had 7 issues that pass every clerk flow dot and 6 more missing only a plan (srs-web#587, #592, #601, #623, #624, #626, #634; #514, #569, #572, #588, #589, #590), none Ready; its one Ready item, srs-web#525, waits on muDemocracy.org#303. Its builder exits with nothing to do on every run.
fieldValues.body: The depth was set to 6 for one consumer (#715); with several lanes it rations readiness across groups instead of per group. Across the governed repos about 78 open issues pass every flow dot and about 53 more miss only a plan; readiness, not shaping, decides what runs. A remedy: a topup depth per lane (each group and the central lane), so every consumer has its own queue.
